verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS parsing platform that ships SDKs and a CLI, so the axis applies. The pack has no documentation of disabling telemetry or usage tracking in the SDKs, CLI or platform. Self-hosting/BYOC and SOC 2 are related privacy features, not an opt-out control, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
